en-US.author: YelovSK
en-US.description: A small, fast Windows image viewer.
en-US.longDescription: Dameview is a Windows image viewer built with C#, Native AOT, Win32, and Direct2D. It ships as a single small executable and supports tabs, split views, a gallery for the open folder, a command palette, color themes, and tiled rendering for large images.
en-US.name: Dameview
